figures.label: Figure S8
figures.caption: Why cascade item pairing accepts a title match at 0·75. (A) Best title similarity for each of the 39 Bayley-4 cognitive items: 27 clear the threshold and pair on title, 12 fall through to full text. The widest gap is 0·84 to 0·96, so 0·75 marks a sparse region rather than the emptiest one. (B) Pairings differing from the adopted solution across thresholds 0·60 to 0·90. The solution is unchanged throughout 0·68 to 0·77. From 0·78 correct matches between reworded titles are rejected (Grouping: Size with Concept Grouping: Size); from 0·83 four pairings differ; below 0·68 spurious title matches are admitted, two by 0·63. 0·75 is therefore supported by the stability of the solution, not by a clean split in the distribution.
